name: Stepping Up Security
label: Quest
description: Stepping Up Security: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your performance has been truly exemplary so far, friend. Our supply lines are not completely safe yet, however. In the absence of dredge strikers, their larger southern cousins will surely move in to take their place in the north.
You'll have to kill quite a few dredge crushers to keep them at bay, but we cannot leave the safety of our supply lines to chance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The dredge crushers are a serious threat and must be dealt with at once!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! You've proven to be a valuable ally in preparing for the war against the silithid.
